system.description:
United by their efforts to touch the Divine and their belief in the One and Prime from which all things originate.

Affiliation: Traditions
Affinity Spheres: Prime; Forces, or Spirit
system.focus: The Arts flow from faith, unity and harmony with the Divine Will rather than personal intent. Song – many voices joined in harmony – is the oldest instrument, and magick manifests in light, fire, warmth and sublime music through faith and High Ritual.
